test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people - A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H - are sitting around a circular table, all facing outward.

D is third to the right of A.

B is sitting opposite D.

G is an immediate neighbor of both D and F.

C sits to the immediate right of F. (Modified from ""second to the left ")

E is third to the right of B.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of E?
solution:
Given: Eight people - A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H, are sitting around a circular table, all facing outward.

D is third to the right of A.

B is sitting opposite D.

G is an immediate neighbor of both D and F.

C sits to the immediate right of F. 

E is third to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/203972a766f01ac4169ca2c5cdc8b142c45daf81bca15b1b9c92e5168d5fd4e4.png] 

So, D is sitting to the immediate right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
